Danish Fugitive from Justice

By: Michael Duffett | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Exclusive Footage of shocking confessions

Summary:
This is a story of a Danish fugitive from justice (gun offences, exposives etc) who somehow managed to get into this country and set up a gun shop in Bloemfontein. He would marry a Lesotho woman and then last month he was arrested , after his wife went to the police to say that she was drugged and when she woke up her clitoris had been removed. The police raided his home and found 12 bits and pieces of female genetalia. Last week, the wife, the state’s main witness was assassinated.

The story is told through 2 Danish journalists who became acquainted with the Danish fugitive of justice Peter Frederekson last year. They had written a book which was sold in Denmark and became very popular. Called the Black Widow it was the story of a Danish millionaire who was murdered by his ex wife and sister and brother in Cape Town. Frederickson said that he has an even better story for the journalists and he gave a long interview on camera, which we can have access to: He was arrested a few months later and how he must regret giving that interview.

He describes his fascination with clitoral removal, his training in it and how he attended cultural practices of clitoral removal in Lesotho. He admits his criminal past and he also admits to trying to have his ex wife in SA murdered. He was actually was arrested for this but says he bribed officials to have the case dropped.

In this story we ask how easy it is for criminals to come into this country.
We tell his bizarre story with input from a forensiz psychiatrist who can describe the personality of such a man who wants notoriety. We can get an expert to talk about the practice of clitoral removal in some cultures. We can speak to the Hawks to tell us the status of the case. And we can unpack the assassination of his wife by revealing what he said in his exclusive interview – that he once tried to have his ex wife murdered in South Africa.
It should be gripping.

Press Release:


Genital Mutilation
When Peter Frederiksen was recently arrested following a tip-off from his estranged late wife, 21 pieces of severed, preserved female genitalia were discovered in his Bloemfontein home. Adding to the media frenzy that followed, was the shocking discovery that Frederiksen - having fled to South Africa in 2006 to evade a 6-month prison sentence – was a fugitive from Danish law. As he awaits trial for his alleged gruesome crimes, Carte Blanche’s exclusive footage reveals his long-standing fascination with the practice of genital mutilation.


Script:


The international media descended upon Bloemfontein last week, not only to cover the States appeal against the conviction of Oscar Pistorius, but also to report on the bail hearing of 63-year-old Danish national, Peter Frederiksen. This following the gruesome discovery of 21 female genitalia found in his freezer,. police were alerted to when his estranged wife, pictured here, told them that he had allegedly drugged her and mutilated her genetalia..

LINK: AFTER HIS ARREST FREDERIKSEN APPEARED IN COURT LATE LAST MONTH FACING MULTIPLE CHARGES. TODAY THE 7TH OF NOVEMBER HE IS BACK IN COURT FOR A BAIL APPLICATION AND PERHAPS NOT SURPRISGLIY, THE CASE HAS ATTRACTED SIGNIFICANT MEDIA INTEREST.

These include including assault, conspiracy to commit murder, possession and production and distribution of child pornography and contraventions of the medicines’ act.

Frederiksen is fugitive from justice from Denmark. Danish prosecutors confirmed that he received a six-month prison sentence in Denmark in 2010 for illegal possession of several firearms and ammunition found in his home. But he had fled to South Africa in 2006 before his trial, allegedly on fraudulently obtained documents ,and set up a business.

LINK: FREDERERIKSEN OWNS TWO GUNSHOPS. ONE IN MASERU IN LESOTHO AND THIS ONE HERE IN BLOEM.

Peter: All the farmers had a submachines gun like this in their houses to use if they were attacked by the blacks.

He met and married Basutu Anna Matseliso Molise, also known is Thsidi in 2010 and they had two children together.

LINK: SO WHAT ELSE DO WE KNOW ABOUT FREDERIKSEN? WELL QUITE A LOT AS IT TURNS OUT THANKS TO TWO DANISH JOURNALISTS LIVING IN SOUTH AFRICA. THEY GOT A RARE GLIMPSE INTO HIS LIFE AND INTO THE WORKINGS OF HIS MIND WHEN AN ASTONISHING SEQUENCE OF EVENTS BROUGHT THEM TOGETHER.

They covered a sensational trial, which took place in the Western Cape several years ago.. Danish millionaire Preben Povlsen was brutally murdered and his Ugandan wife Maria Povlsen and her sister were found guilty of accessories to his murder. Helle wrote a book on the case, which went on to become a bestseller in Denmark. Her book was read by none other than Peter Frederiksen.

Helle: and then he called me and said I have a better story to tell.
John: And when you heard about this call, what was your response Jorn?
Jorn: I said we have to maybe find out one day but you know we get many funny calls from people so it was not anything special a that time...

Jorn and Helle are seasoned journalists who have filmed and covered many warzones globally including the Rwandan Genocide. But nothing could prepare them for the story they were about to hear from Frederiksen.

Jorn: He is one of the most weird persons we have met in our professional life as journalists and we have met quite a few.

After persistent calls from Frederiksen they finally travelled to Bloemfontein where they interviewed and filmed him for a full three days in June this year.. A recurring subject was his obsession with guns, which he had from a very early age. He even told them how he illegally collected weapons.

Peter: Well in the meantime I had built up quite a collection of machine guns, submachine guns, a number of pistols and some explosives as well and some other hand grenades and other things could get hold of.

The journalists said that they were surprised at how quickly frederekson divulged personal details about himself.

John: So if I understand you correctly, you sat down at lunch and he started telling you about his nipple piercings?
Helle: Yes.
John: And that you found a little bit strange.
Helle: Indeed.
John: First impressions obviously important. I imagine that your first impressions weren’t particularly good? Would that be fair?
Helle: I mean you didn’t think of him like a monster. He was looking fairly normal.
Jorn: A few other things which out you off. I mean Like he was into this bondage thing as well which is completely normal in my mind but it isn’t the first thing you tell people the very first time you meet them. I find that a bit odd.

Peter: It started in Denmark 20 years ago. I frequented a bondage club in Copenhagen called SMIL. There I met a female priest and she was totally obsessed by this.

Frederiksen said that she was desperate to have her clitoral hood removed. His interest was peaked but he needed training first.

Peter: And here Jorn Ege enters the picture.

The late Dr Jorn Ege, infamous for his penis enlargement procedures apparently trained Frederiksen (on the procedure)

Peter: So he explained in great detail that you have to do this and do that to stop the bleeding and all those things.

He told them how he used his newfound skills on the female priest, much to her delight.

Peter: And after 8-10 days her wounds were healed with some special cream. She was excited. She was so happy for having it done.

The interview then took a sinister turn when he described how he began enquiring about Female Genital Mutilation after he moved to South Africa. He had heard that the practice was still taking place in south Africa and in Lesotho, where He was invited to a ritual, he claims.

Peter: And one time I am taken up and I am probably the only white man who has been allowed to observe circumcisions of women and children in Lesotho.
And the lady says "Well do you have any experience in this kind of thing? Then I said "Yes I have a little experience because I can do it so it is not painful. Because you don’t use local anesthetic. You just cut."

According to UNICEF, over 125 million girls and women have undergone female genital mutilation in the 29 North African and Middle Eastern countries where the practice is mainly concentrated.
According to some reports, forms of female genital mutilation including cutting are performed in Lesotho – but Dr Tlala, a gynaecologist practicing in Maseru,who has inspected 1000's of lesotho women has never fond any evidence of this.


Tlale: I have never ever seen a patient who had a scar on the clitoris. At least I have never seen a Basotho who is mutilated...But there is actually no removal of any tissues in all the women that I have ever come across whom I had to give an internal exam or external genital examination or an internal examination. I've never ever seen a Basotho who had her clitoris removed.

But police found 21 severed pieces of female genetalia in Frerekkson’s freezer. Frekerson’s wife, Tsidi told a film crew from Ekstra Bladett, a Danish tabloid she felt she had been drugged one night and when she woke she was in unbearable pain. He clitoris had been removed. She asked him why he did it and he said, and we quote – “my wife has to be clean!


Frederiksen actually showed Helle and jjorn pictures of what he had done to his wife

Interview: We were disgusted

But the extent of Frederickson alleged crimes only became apparent to helle and jorn when he was arrested.

Link

As a result of her assassination and death threats to justice officials, security at the court house has been dramatically increased. The investigating officer is flanked by a tactical team as well as the prosecutors. The court has ordered that all court official’s names and identities are protected.

Question: WHAT DO YOU KNOW ABOUT THIS ASSISNATION?

Answer: WHAT DO WE KNOW, WE KNOW FOR SURE THAT SINCE HE HAS TRIED BEFORE WITH HIS FORMER GIRL FIRND AND HIRED A HITMAN IN IN MASERU WHO EVENTUALLY SHOT HIMSELF IN THE LEG INSTEAD OF HER.


It appears to have been a botched attempt. Frederiksone says that he was implicated and arrested by Lesotho police . He told them that he had bribed a judge from Lesotho to make the case disappear.

Peter: He came after two weeks. He brought all the documents and said “how much are you going to pay me?. I said “how much do you want? He said “give me R4000”
No I give you R3500

Frederisken told helle and jorn that he rang the judge later to tell him that he had videotaped their meeting.

Peter: I tell you he didn’t sleep well that night.”

Jorn and Helle are still baffled as to why Frederiksen was adamant to tell his story knowing that it would probably be broadcast and incrimate him. In the meantime the bail hearing continues next week and frederiksen legal team has indicated that he will take the stand. The hawks are desperately searching for more victims to come forward. They believe they are dealing with an extremely dangerous man.

Peter: I am absolutely not raised to kill anyone. Absolutely not. But I strongly believe it can be necessary to do these kinds of things if you want to survive youself.

The story is told through 2 Danish journalists who became acquainted with the Danish fugitive of justice Peter Frederekson last year. They had written a book which was sold in Denmark and became very popular. Called the Black Widow it was the story of a Danish millionaire who was murdered by his ex wife and sister and brother in Cape Town. Frederickson said that he has an even better story for the journalists and he gave a long interview on camera, which we can have access to: He was arrested a few months later and how he must regret giving that interview. He describes his fascination with clitoral removal, his training in it and how he attended cultural practices of clitoral removal in Lesotho. He admits his criminal past and he also admits to trying to have his ex wife in SA murdered. He was actually was arrested for this but says he bribed officials to have the case dropped. In this story we ask how easy it is for criminals to come into this country. We tell his bizarre story with input from a forensiz psychiatrist who can describe the personality of such a man who wants notoriety. We can get an expert to talk about the practice of clitoral removal in some cultures. We can speak to the Hawks to tell us the status of the case. And we can unpack the assassination of his wife by revealing what he said in his exclusive interview – that he once tried to have his ex wife murdered in South Africa. It should be gripping.
